# Metadata supports scalar and flat-array JSON values, and preserves them on disk.
exec weft$exe init
exec weft$exe add 'Metadata record' --state todo

exec weft$exe meta set 001 note '"a string"' --json
json
exec weft$exe meta set 001 count 4 --json
json
exec weft$exe meta set 001 ratio -- -1.25
exec weft$exe meta set 001 enabled true
exec weft$exe meta set 001 absent null
exec weft$exe meta set 001 values '["x", 2, false, null]'

exec weft$exe meta get 001 --json
json
stdout '"note": "a string"'
stdout '"count": 4'
stdout '"ratio": -1.25'
stdout '"enabled": true'
stdout '"absent": null'
stdout '"values": '

exec weft$exe meta get 001 count --json
json
stdout '"key": "count"'
stdout '"value": 4'
exec weft$exe meta get 001 note
stdout 'note = "a string"'
exec weft$exe meta get 001
stdout 'absent = null'
stdout 'enabled = true'
stdout 'note = "a string"'

exec weft$exe show 001
stdout 'note: a string'
stdout 'values: '
stdout 'false, null'
exec weft$exe check --json
json
stdout '"ok": true'

exec weft$exe meta unset 001 count
stdout 'Unset count'
exec weft$exe meta unset 001 missing
stdout 'missing is not set'
exec weft$exe meta unset 001 missing --json
json
exec weft$exe meta get 001 --json
json
! stdout '"count":'

! exec weft$exe meta get 001 missing
stderr 'metadata key "missing" is not set'
! exec weft$exe meta set 001 object '{"nested": 1}'
stderr 'metadata value must be one JSON scalar or flat array'
! exec weft$exe meta set 001 nested '[[1, 2]]'
stderr 'metadata value must be one JSON scalar or flat array'
! exec weft$exe meta set 001 invalid 'not-json'
stderr 'metadata value must be one JSON scalar or flat array'
! exec weft$exe meta set 001 '' '"value"'
stderr 'metadata key cannot be empty'
! exec weft$exe meta set 001 number 10
stderr 'reserved by Weft'
! exec weft$exe meta set 001 order 10
stderr 'reserved by Weft'
! exec weft$exe meta set 001 created_at '"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"'
stderr 'reserved by Weft'
! exec weft$exe meta set 001 completed_at '"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"'
stderr 'reserved by Weft'
! exec weft$exe meta unset 001 number
stderr 'reserved by Weft'
! exec weft$exe meta get 001 missing --json
stderr 'metadata key "missing" is not set'

exec weft$exe rename 001 'Metadata record renamed'
exec weft$exe move 001 doing
exec weft$exe show 001 --json
json
stdout '"title": "Metadata record renamed"'
stdout '"note": "a string"'
stdout '"values":'
exists tasks/doing/001-metadata-record-renamed.md
exec weft$exe check --json
json
stdout '"ok": true'
